versions.changelog:
**Summary:** Adds new robotics & embodied AI developments and expands autonomous driving simulation coverage.

- Updated Autonomous Driving Simulation section with ConFixGS (confidence-aware diffusion repair) and its applicability.
- Significantly expanded Robotics & Embodied AI: added new sub-directions, tools, and key papers (GaussianGrasper, GraspSplats, ManiGaussian, RoboSplat, GSMem, VR-Robo, Forecast-GS) and clarified 3DGS vs. NeRF for manipulation.
- Added "World Model Integration" section outlining 3DGS as a core primitive for world models, example methods per domain, and engineering implications.
- Clarified maturity/role for Robotics & Embodied AI to "Rapidly Growing" with improved structuring.
- No changes to the base engineering stack or other verticals.

3dgs-engineering-guide v1.0.3

- Added an organized industry overview covering 10 application verticals for 3D Gaussian Splatting, each with pipelines, quality bars, standards, and key notes.
- Expanded engineering stack details: data acquisition, reconstruction frameworks, post-processing methods, and deployment toolchains, including hardware/software recommendations and compression strategies.
- Highlighted actionable next steps, common pitfalls, and domain-specific quality/security requirements.
- Updated references to integration standards (S3M, OGC 3D Tiles, IFC), tool suggestions (COLMAP, splat-transform, SuperSplat), and methods for mesh extraction, material separation, and relighting.
- Enhanced instructions for practical guidance: identify use case, recommend pipelines, cite papers, and warn about domain-specific issues.
